The Xitsonga people have a rich cultural heritage, and naming practices play a significant role in expressing their values and beliefs. Thando is a name that speaks to the importance of love and affection in the Xitsonga community. It is a name that reflects the value that the Xitsonga people place on their relationships with one another and the deep emotional ties that bind them together.
